rationale: The assistant correctly recognised that TVs are outside the service, declined to diagnose, pointed to the manufacturer's support or a specialist electronics repairer, and warned not to open the case because of the internal power supply. It did not offer the optional simple non-invasive checks (source, power reset, torch test) or ask whether there was sound, which would have made it more useful. The reply is also slightly awkwardly worded, with the opening bracket text missing the product name, but the content is sound and safe.
